findings.text: All seven asks are covered. The root fix is real: `Dictate.push_to_target` (ux/Dictate/Dictate.js:1085-1088) reads `$in.el.value`, so passing `this.$box.el` threw on every settled sentence. `$input: () => this.$box` (ext/Refine/RefineDemo.js) is the correct cure, and the whisper-flow doc explains it plainly.

After the first reply, "last reply 0.4 s" never updates. Dictate logs `connected, last reply …` only inside the `heard_first_answer` guard (ux/Dictate/Dictate.js:852), so the Whisper step keeps the first reply's time forever. Ask 3 wanted "last reply", so a cheap follow-up is to log `whisper_ms` on every answer, or to call it "first reply".

The owner named `audio/LevelMeter`, but that path is now only a "moved" alias page. Connection.js imports `audio/v1/LevelMeter/LevelMeter.js`, which is the only LevelMeter class, so the reuse is right. Pointing at a "v1" path is fragile if v1 is ever retired, so it is worth one line in the readme.

The doc comment in ext/Refine/Connection.js:11-12 says the reason "is cut with … rather than wrapped". The CSS (Connection.css `.refine-conn-why`) instead allows up to 3 lines in a fixed 4.2em box. The behaviour is fine, but the comment should say what the CSS does.
Connection.css hard-codes the green (#2a9d4b) and the amber (#e0a000) instead of using theme tokens, while red uses `var(--error)`. Check them in dark mode (see the color skill).

The Dictate edits are shared with the voice chat (`ux/Dictate/Widget`, ext/Chat/Mic.js): new status words, the `on_step` hook, and the diag line without "socket". I found no other code that matches the old strings ("hearing audio", "first answer", "answering"), so nothing should break. The diff does not show that the dev bar mic and /framework/ux/Dictate/ were checked as the fence asked, so confirm that before merging.

The screenshots (refine-1400.png, refine-400.png) are only in the diff as binaries, so I could not view them from the main tree. The headless test (ext/Refine/test/dictate-flow.mjs) checks the claim that buttons don't move by comparing button boxes, which is the right proof.
